audit_items.title: Verify Data Column Sidecar Gossip Validation: Is the 13-step validation pipeline complete?

phase1_code_analysis.code_summary: The DataColumnSidecarGossipValidator.validate() method implements gossip validation for data column sidecars per the Fulu (PeerDAS) spec. The validation pipeline includes structural verification, duplicate detection, slot timing checks, finalization checks, parent availability, parent validity, parent slot ordering, finalized checkpoint ancestry, inclusion proof verification, KZG proof verification, proposer index verification, and proposer signature verification.
validation_steps_found: 2. [IGNORE] First sidecar for (slot, proposer_index, index) tuple - dedup check (line 204)
3. [REJECT] Correct subnet - delegated to TopicSubnetIdAwareOperationProcessor (line 211-214, comment)
4. [IGNORE] Not from future slot with MAXIMUM_GOSSIP_CLOCK_DISPARITY allowance (line 219)
5. [IGNORE] Slot greater than latest finalized slot (line 227)
6. [IGNORE/SAVE_FOR_FUTURE] Parent block seen via gossip and non-gossip (line 248)
7. [REJECT] Parent block passes validation / not in invalidBlockRoots (line 265)
8. [REJECT] Sidecar from higher slot than parent (line 272)
9. [REJECT] Finalized checkpoint is ancestor of sidecar's block (line 279)
10. [REJECT] KZG commitments inclusion proof valid via verify_data_column_sidecar_inclusion_proof (line 288)
12. [REJECT] Proposed by expected proposer_index for slot (line 320)

phase2_property_verification.property_statement: The 13-step data column sidecar gossip validation pipeline must be complete, with all steps executed in sequence, REJECT preventing forwarding, and IGNORE allowing re-processing.
phase2_property_verification.analysis: All 13 gossip validation steps from the consensus-specs Fulu p2p-interface are implemented. The validation pipeline follows the spec ordering. REJECT results in InternalValidationResult.reject() which prevents gossip forwarding. IGNORE results in InternalValidationResult.IGNORE which allows re-processing. SAVE_FOR_FUTURE is used for slot-timing and parent-availability cases, allowing deferred processing. The implementation includes an optimization path (validateDataColumnSidecarWithKnownValidHeader) for subsequent sidecars from the same block that skips already-verified header checks but still performs per-column checks (inclusion proof, KZG proofs, dedup).

helper_validations.verifyDataColumnSidecar: MiscHelpersFulu.verifyDataColumnSidecar() checks: (1) index < numberOfColumns, (2) commitments non-empty, (3) dataColumn.size == commitments.size, (4) dataColumn.size == proofs.size
helper_validations.verifyDataColumnSidecarKzgProofs: MiscHelpersFulu.verifyDataColumnSidecarKzgProofs() delegates to kzg.verifyCellProofBatch() with proper commitment, cell, and proof extraction
helper_validations.verifyDataColumnSidecarInclusionProof: MiscHelpersFulu.verifyDataColumnSidecarInclusionProof() uses Merkle branch verification against block body root

phase3_risk_assessment.rationale: The implementation faithfully follows the consensus-specs Fulu p2p-interface validation rules for data_column_sidecar gossip. All 13 steps are present and correctly ordered. The optimization for known-valid headers is safe because it only skips checks that are invariant across sidecars from the same block (parent availability, proposer, signature) while still performing per-column checks (KZG proofs, inclusion proofs). The dedup check uses a bounded LimitedSet to prevent unbounded memory growth. Test coverage (DataColumnSidecarGossipValidatorTest) covers all validation branches including accept, reject, ignore, and save-for-future cases. No missing steps or bypasses were identified.
potential_considerations: The validInclusionProofInfoSet and validSignedBlockHeaders caches use LimitedSet with bounded sizes, so under extreme conditions cache eviction could cause redundant work but not correctness issues.
The duplicate check at line 204 is a pre-check; the authoritative dedup at line 340 is performed again after all validations pass, correctly handling the non-synchronized nature of the method.
